desc: Team-attack (combo) affinity matrix between character families. File: u32 used_count (167); u16 ids[256] (char.dat tier-0 ids: 10..990 uniques, 1010..1350 human classes incl. Human Dummy 1270-1350, 2010..2330 monster classes incl. dummies; rest 0); u8 m[256][256]. Pseudo-record per row: id + 256 values, value m[row][col] = chance (%) that the column character joins/combos with the row character (asymmetric: Killia row, Seraphina column = 99 but not vice versa; Bloodis/Goldion rows vs Majorita = 0 (enemies), Usalia row vs Majorita = 80). Default 30, same family (diagonal) 50, friends 40-80, 99 = always, 0 = never. A new class/character needs its tier-0 id in a free id slot (replace a 0 or a dummy id) and a row+column of values, otherwise the default rate is not available. Header count NOT auto-updated.

fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of used ids (167); NOT auto-updated

fields.name: id
fields.desc: character family id of this row = char.dat id of tier 0 (10 Killia, 40 Seraphina, 1010 Warrior, 2010 Prinny); 0 = unused slot. Row i and column i refer to the same id-vector slot
